    s=input()
    a.append(s[s.rfind(' ')+1:].casefold())
    b.append(s[:s.find(' ')].casefold())
    c.append(a[i])
    c.append(b[i])
c=[x for i, x in enumerate(c) if c.index(x) == i]
for i in range(n):
    a[i]=c.index(a[i])
    b[i]=c.index(b[i])
d= [[0] * len(c) for i in range(len(c))]
for i in range(len(a)):
    d[a[i]][b[i]]=1
def pi(d, j):
    global k, kmax
    for i in range(len(d)):
        if d[j][i]==1:
            k+=1
            z=i
            pi(d, z)
        if (d[j][i]==0) and (i==len(d)-1):
            if k>kmax:
                kmax=k
            k-=1
k=1
kmax=1
j=0
pi(d, j)
print(kmax)

d['polycarp'] = 1

    a = list(map(str,input().split()))
    b = ''
    for j in range(len(a[0])):
        if ((ord(a[0][j]) >= 65) and (ord(a[0][j]) <= 90)):
            b = b + chr(ord(a[0][j]) + 32)
        else:
            b = b + a[0][j]
    a[0] = b
    b = ''
    for j in range(len(a[2])):
        if ((ord(a[2][j]) >= 65) and (ord(a[2][j]) <= 90)):
            b = b + chr(ord(a[2][j]) + 32)
        else:
            b = b + a[2][j]
    a[2] = b
    d[a[0]] = 1
    d[a[0]] = d[a[0]] + d[a[2]]
    s = a[0]
print(d[s])
